items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: January of ’72 I quit teaching because I went out on the road with Taj Mahal.

ctx.x: I see. You spent some time with — well you’ve got a long, very interesting list of associates. Talk about Charles Mingus a little bit.

Sure. Sure. I got that gig in ’71, 1971. He put together, I think it was some anniversary of the big bands so he put the band back together in 1971. “71? ’72? ‘71 he put the band back together. Because I had just come off the road, that was the January I quit teaching, January of ’72 I quit teaching because I went out on the road with Taj Mahal. That’s when that happened.
